hooks.name: Auto-commit to Git
hooks.description: After each agent turn, stage all changes and create a timestamped local commit if there is anything to commit. Does not push.

action.command: cd "c:/Users/zoewh/Downloads/pharmstock/PharmStock"; if (git status --porcelain) { git add -A; git commit -m ("auto: session changes " + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm')) | Out-Null; Write-Output "Committed local changes." } else { Write-Output "No changes to commit." }
